scripts.build: vite build && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build-assets.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests examples scripts '*.{json,ts}' README.md CHANGELOG.md GLOSSARY.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests examples scripts '*.{json,ts}' README.md CHANGELOG.md GLOSSARY.md
scripts.check:model: pnpm build && pnpm build:model && node scripts/check-package.mjs --model
scripts.test:model: vitest run tests/reactive-model.spec.ts tests/model-password.spec.ts tests/model-value-array.spec.ts tests/public-api.spec.ts
scripts.check:model-business: pnpm build && pnpm build:model-business && node scripts/check-package.mjs --model-business
scripts.check:package: pnpm build && pnpm build:model && node scripts/check-package.mjs --model
